notes: Redesigned UI to match the new reference mockups. Bottom nav now has 5 tabs: Finance, Home, Analytics, AI, and Profile (AI assistant and Profile are now their own tabs instead of a chat button/avatar tap). Finance gets a Quick Actions row (Add Expense, Add Income, Split Expenses, Search). Home gets a Daily Summary row (spent today, tasks left, streak, budget status). Analytics gets time-range filters (7D/30D/3M/6M/1Y/All), a grouped income-vs-expense bar chart, savings rate, average daily spend, and a Financial Health Score. Transactions (formerly Ledger) gets search, All/Income/Expense filters, and date-grouped sections. Profile is redesigned with real stats (transactions, goals, habits, health score) and grouped settings sections.
